messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — HelixHealth just finished onboarding and dropped a doc with 12 feature asks and a few pain notes. Need a quick, repeatable capture so we can hand to product triage.
Jordan (Product): Can you paste the asks or a link? we should bucket by impact + effort.
Maya (CS): Link: https://redwood.app/helix/onboard-asks (private). Summary: majority are routing/ui tweaks, two are model-behavior asks (safety and hallucination), one is per-route billing visibility.
Ethan (AE): FYI renewal is in 9 weeks — we should capture urgent items that block go-live.
Priya (Onboarding): I noticed three of these came from their legal/compliance team — might be higher priority for Private deployment customers.
sam-bot (CS Ops): New capture template created: /templates/quick-capture-v1 — use for all onboarding asks.
Maya (CS): Proposed quick form (1-min):
```
- Customer: HelixHealth
- Submitter: Onboarding
- Short ask (1 sentence):
- Why it matters (customer impact):
- Severity: blocker / high / medium / low
- Suggested workaround
- Attachments/links
```
Jordan (Product): Love that. Add a field: "Expected frequency / affected routes" — helps estimate cost.
Ethan (AE): For renewals, anything labelled blocker -> flag to Customer Success priority lane.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll fill the 3 compliance asks into the form and tag them as high.
Maya (CS): Who owns the initial prioritization? My recommendation: CS triage (Maya) tags severity, Product does effort estimate, then PM queue.
Jordan (Product): Agreed. I'll add a lightweight rubric in the triage doc: impact score (1-5), effort (S/M/L), regulatory flag.
Maya (CS): Quick ask: can Product review the two model-behavior asks this week? They look like potential quality regressions.
Jordan (Product): Yup — I'll pull them into our weekly intake on Wednesday. Please link the prompt examples + failing output.
Maya (CS): Will add examples to the form before sending.
Ethan (AE): Also flag that per-route billing visibility item influences procurement conversations. Marking as medium-high.
Priya (Onboarding): Sending filled forms now — pinging the triage channel when done. :rocket:
Maya (CS): Thanks — once Product acknowledges, we'll loop Legal and success.
Jordan (Product): Noted. Reminder: when you tag "blocker" include desired SLA or timeline. Helps prioritize in a sprint.
Maya (CS): Good call. I'll update the template with a small timeline field.
Ethan (AE): One more — can we add a checkbox "Affects renewal" for AE reporting?
Jordan (Product): Sure — add as a boolean field.
Maya (CS): Perfect. Closing loop: template link + triage rubric will live in the onboarding playbook. I'll DM the link when ready.
Priya (Onboarding): Quick win: added 3 compliance asks, 1 billing, 2 model-behavior, rest product/ux.
Maya (CS): Great — thanks team.
sam-bot (CS Ops): Capture stored: /captures/1739876543-helixhealth.json (access controlled).
Maya (CS): Thread done unless someone needs more from me. :white_check_mark:
